next.reason: 1985: 'The USE statement is never executed; it merely defines the conditions calling for the execution of the USE procedures.' 2023 §2023:14.9.49.4 GR1: 'The USE statement defines the conditions calling for the execution of the use procedures', and §2023:14.5.1 classes it as a declarative statement that 'directs that actions be taken in response to specified conditions'; no 2023 rule gives USE any run-time action when control reaches it (e.g. a PERFORMed declarative section). Same effect.
